snr_definition: CONVENTIONS.md section SNR (review note a); F solved per bin from sigma_pix and s
noise_note: noise model is the step-1 placeholder (MAD artefact); step 3 fits it. Slopes and ratios to the bound are the step-2 result; absolute values are provisional.
noise_free_check_note: fixed flux for the noise-free checks (redesigned 23 Oct: at bin fluxes the trail light falls under the COM threshold, so the per-cell check cannot survive); noise off, quantize on; clips the rest cells only (symmetric); see noise_free_checks for the tolerance design
rest_note: rest is a point source at the label (one zero-distance segment); changed from 15.0 on 23 Oct so rest is not a copy of uniform_15px
trail_note: segment list = px moved per EQUAL time step (constant speed: one segment = whole trail, all 0.1 px sub-steps share the light equally). nonuniform = speed ramp 1x->1.5x->2x->3x along the trail, review note f. Trail axis = +col.

nonuniform_mirror.name: nonuniform_15px_mirror
nonuniform_mirror.note: mechanism test for the COM bias direction (LESSONS 1): ramp 3x->1x. Predicted: mean vs mid-time label flips sign per axis. It runs at the top four SNR bins only.

label_note: label = mid-time position = patch centre (CONVENTIONS Patch centre); the trail is placed around it

fit_names.gaussian_on_moffat: model mismatch, separate line (review note g)

crlb_note: numeric Fisher from this noise model; parameters row, col, flux, background; ignores 8-bit rounding and the clip at 0, so it is a floor and the gap grows at low SNR (review note d)
